race.comment: LADY OLENNA (9) had the two mixed runs in Highway class and look for an improved performance on her home track. Wasn't disgraced from the wide gate with a tiring tenth at Randwick over 1200m. Was a month between runs last start and strips fitter for this. Sure to go close despite drawing out again. NOVA CENTAURI (10) is a talented mare who was massively outclassed when twelfth to Perfumist over 1400m at Newcastle in the G3 Tibbie last Friday. Assess on the good earlier runs. Can return to form quickly. ZUMBO (7) returned from a lengthy spell with an encouraging eighth over 1200m at Randwick in Highway grade. Should get the trip and can race a touch closer here. FLAMBOYANT LAD (4) appreciated the better set-up second up when going under narrowly to finish second over 1400m at Mudgee. Hard fit now and must be respected with the claim. The chances don't end there.
